sources.title: MOSS Voice-Acting — Technical Report - a Hugging Face Space by laion
sources.snippet: The shipped v2 model is documented in a public manual: MOSS Voice-Acting — Manual & Studies Hub (mirror at laion-ai.github.io). It is 25 chapters: a hub, an emotion-conditioning manual with one page per emotion, twelve recipe chapters, and an eight-page tree recording an autonomous casting agent's four generations of runs.

sources.title: How to Fine-Tune an LLM: SFT, LoRA, QLoRA and DPO Explained
sources.snippet: A practical guide to fine-tuning LLMs with SFT, LoRA, QLoRA and DPO, using a Llama 3.1 8B persona model project.

sources.title: MOSS Voice-Acting — Emotion LoRAs vs Baseline - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Emotion LoRAs — does a specialist adapter help, and what does it cost? 17 adapters, each trained on the top 1 % of its own emotion (filtered so that measured naturalness and vocal-burst blend are both above the corpus median), rank 16, 5 epochs. sources.title: LAION
sources.snippet: LAION, as a non-profit organization, provides datasets, tools and models to liberate machine learning research. By doing so, we encourage open public education and a more environment-friendly use of resources by reusing existing datasets and models.
